# Team and advisors — editable one-slide template

Open [team-advisors.pptx](team-advisors.pptx) in a presentation editor. All
visible content is native text and remains editable. The slide uses the
landing page's ivory, ink and orange palette. A [PNG preview](team-advisors.png)
is included for a quick look.

Replace bracketed placeholders before presenting. The builder block asks for
a name, a specific contribution, linked evidence and relevant experience.
Describe your actual decisions and verified work, including where AI assisted;
do not substitute repository size or generated code for personal ownership.

The two advisor blocks deliberately say **Open role**. They suggest a markets
practitioner to challenge execution/cost assumptions and a distribution advisor
to help reach independent strategy builders. Change the gaps if needed. Add a
person's name or affiliation only after they agree to the role. An introduction
or conversation is not an appointment.

The closing request asks for one introduction for each open gap. Replace it
with the concrete next action you want from the audience. Keep the deck to one
page, preview it after editing, and check that longer names and evidence links
fit. The current preview and package were checked locally; opening in a
different editor can change font substitution and wrapping.

This is a reusable template, not evidence that any advisor has joined. No
people, employment history, customer traction or commitments are asserted.
